item.title: How Asia Is Building the First Fully Integrated Digital Corridor
item.summary: Across Asia, governments, telecommunications companies, cloud providers, and satellite operators are increasingly treating digital infrastructure as interconnected systems. The result is the emergence of what could become the world’s first fully integrated digital corridor where subsea cables, low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellites, and data centers function as a single regional ecosystem.
